purpose: Compare virtual W01–W04 marker centers to physical landmarks to validate production T_ARWorld_Wall
method: While Localization = localized and Markers = 4/4, compare each predicted marker center to the identifiable physical point. Do not treat prediction as its own ground truth. Do not apply S_wall_colmap again. Do not use the 2 cm local-metric GT uncertainty as an AR PASS/FAIL threshold.
w02Note: W02 remains in the runtime marker set. Its inner/outer frame-corner tape distances are not local-metric GT. Record AR placement against the same physical identity if it can be pointed to; otherwise note ambiguity.
